name: Storage Box with Lid
description: A parametric box in four footprints (rectangle, rounded, hexagon, round) with optional grid dividers and a friction, sliding dovetail or snap-fit lid. Box and lid print side by side without supports; optional lid text is inlaid in a third colour. Defaults give an 80 x 60 x 40 mm inside rounded box with a friction lid.
source: inspired by Printables Rugged Box (Parametric) and MakerWorld Parametric Box with Lid / Box with Slide Lid
